BASE_EXPOSURE: full-size BTC perpetual in direction BTC_SIDE(t)
CONFIRMATION_COMPARATOR: RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION. Frozen D2 year-matched convention is retained. On a single-year 2025 surface it reduces to selecting exactly K eligible 2025 rows uniformly without replacement. No month/quarter matching added.
CONFIRMATION_PRACTICAL_GATE: DELTA >= 0.20 * UNCONDITIONAL_MEAN on the independent 2025 surface. Same discovery-era 20% relative bar. Not lowered. Not replaced by the observed +1.42pp discovery DELTA.
CONFIRMATION_RULE: ABSTAIN(t)=1 iff ev.rv_btc_24h(t) > P90 of its own trailing 250 completed decision-point values with t excluded. No threshold sweep.
CONFIRMATION_STATISTICAL_GATE: MU_RULE > P95 of the 10000 RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION replicate mean-severity values. Authoritative pass rule. Monte Carlo one-sided p=(1+count(control_mean>=MU_RULE))/(1+N_REPLICATES) is reported only; it does not replace the percentile gate.
CONFIRMATION_TARGET: 24h direction-aligned adverse-path severity using the exact existing 288 x 5m future-bar construction (arithmetic MAE). Not terminal return, close-only MAE, MFE, drawdown, volatility, or PnL.
DECISION_SCHEDULE: one daily BTC decision on MARKET-05/06 00:05:00Z grid

DISCOVERY_PROVENANCE_NOT_EVIDENCE.note: Adaptive discovery only. Not evidence. Not the confirmatory minimum effect.

WARMUP: Trailing-250 feature history may use already-exposed 2024 decision points. 2025 outcomes remain unexposed. Metrics are computed only on 2025 T.
WHY_NOT_CONSUME_2026: 2026 is a second reserved surface for later replication/follow-up if justified. Combining 2025+2026 to increase N is forbidden. Underpowering does not automatically consume 2026.

power.method: Year-cycled empirical 2021-2024 severity vectors. For each outer replicate, a random K-subset (K = frozen-rule abstain count that year) is location-shifted so DELTA/UNCONDITIONAL_MEAN equals the predeclared relative effect. Inner RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION uses 10000 uniform-without-replacement draws. The random subset is used so power is evaluated at the predeclared effect rather than at the observed discovery DELTA.
